headlines.text: It was 2023 when Jamie Hayter vs. Emi Sakura met in an Eliminator Match, topping the bill that night on Rampage, rated 8.15 ? one of the better matches of the year. Sakura, a wrestler Hayter deeply respects, pushed the champion to her limit in a title eliminator before three Exploder suplexes and a Ripcord lariat retained Hayter's reign.

On a Saturday in 2024, back when FTR & Garcia vs. House of Black settled things in an Escape the Cage Elimination match, headlining the show on Collision, rated 8.22 ? a genuinely great match in a wild trios sprint. FTR and Garcia outlasted House of Black in a brutal elimination steel cage match, with Mark Briscoe slamming the cage door on Malakai Black to secure Garcia's escape and the win.
That Wednesday in 2021, Jungle Boy vs. Dax Harwood locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 7.85 ? a solid showing.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2023, it was the first-ever encounter between Adam Page and Wheeler Yuta, getting things started right out of the gate on Rampage, rated 7.78 ? a match that delivered.
Rewind to 2024, when AEW welcomed STP (Moriarty & Taylor) for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.63.

Rewind to 2021, when The Good Brothers vs. The Young Bucks vs. Dark Order (Grayson & Uno) vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) vs. Karl Anderson vs. Luke Gallows vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Evil Uno vs. Stu Grayson vs. Alex Reynolds vs. John Silver headlined Dynamite, rated 7.52 ? a good, competitive contest.
